title: Fast ChainPilot
tagline: Empowering users with seamless on-chain interactions using AI-driven agents
description: Fast ChainPilot is a cutting-edge decentralized assistant designed to streamline on-chain interactions using natural language. By integrating AgentKit, it empowers users to effortlessly manage crypto wallets, execute transactions, and interact with decentralized applications (dApps). With features like wallet connectivity, network switching, and real-time transaction insights, Fast ChainPilot simplifies blockchain operations, making them accessible to both novice and advanced users.
how_its_made:
Fast ChainPilot leverages the power of AgentKit to provide seamless on-chain interactions. The project uses the Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP) to handle wallet connections, account authentication, and transaction management, ensuring secure and efficient blockchain operations.

The chatbot interface is built using LangChain, providing a natural language processing layer for intuitive user interactions. The frontend is developed using React with TypeScript, incorporating modular UI components for responsiveness and usability. MobX is used for state management, ensuring smooth and reactive updates to user actions.

On the backend, Node.js with Express manages API integrations and interaction flows between the chatbot and blockchain networks. AgentKit's pre-built actions are extended with custom workflows for advanced features like multi-network support (e.g., Ethereum, Base, and Sepolia) and real-time transaction monitoring.
